create_MPCActor: create an MPCActor instance with an environment, horizon H, and paths per CPU for model predictive control
run_get_action: run get_action on the MPCActor to compute the optimal action for a given environment state
test_score_trajectory: test the score_trajectory method to compute discounted cumulative rewards for a list of trajectory paths
